parts.text: Chromium, copper and nickel are transition elements.

parts.text: (c) Two ions that contain chromium are chromate( VI ) ions, CrO 4 2– , and dichromate( VI ) ions, Cr 2 O 7 2– . H + (aq) ions convert CrO 4 2– (aq) ions to Cr 2 O 7 2– (aq) ions. An equilibrium is reached. 2H + (aq) + 2CrO 4 2– (aq) Cr 2 O 7 2– (aq) + H 2 O(l) chromate( VI ) dichromate( VI )
